pairs.subject: subsystem-review-doctrine
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/useScanTab.ts:350 The pass selector lets a user deselect the ground-truth pass and still run structure/quality/performance (which cli-task-handlers.ts just concatenates per selected pass), so later passes can conclude on premises nothing confirmed, and there is no 'not run, blocked on premise' state.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/useScanTab.ts:350 Any non-empty subset of passes may run. Ground-truth is not a gating prerequisite, and passes run as independent prompts with no entitlement chain or blocked state.

src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/index.tsx:273 A ground-truth pass exists and is on by default (lib prompt has identity/members/observable behaviour/refusal). But the finding schema only allows a findings array, and a refusal ([]) renders as an empty/clean list here. The refusal is never reported as a result.

src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/ScanDelta.tsx:90 Three buckets plus notRescanned scope restriction and line-free matching are realized. But 'cleared' does not split resolved-by-deletion from fixed, the buckets are totals with no severity breakdown, and nothing promotes findings that persist across 3 runs.

src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/constants.ts:19 Effort is shown as its own axis with wall-clock bands (~5m/~30m/~2h/>2h) beside severity. Severity is shown as a distribution, not averaged (index.tsx summary stats). The impact-based severity ladder lives in the lib prompt.

src/components/modules/core-engine/ScanTab/useScanTab.ts:49 The selector exposes the module's trace pass (combat-trace for arpg-combat, constants.ts PASS_ICONS) as an optional fifth pass. Only one module defines a trace, and that is a lib-level choice.
